title: Unit 2: Complete Key Vocabulary & Terminology (14 Words) 📚
content: 📌 Welcome Freshmen Students to Communicative English Skills II (EnLa102) - Unit 2! 👋✨ Here is the complete vocabulary list for Unit 2: Speculations About the Future of Science, formatted with bold colors and line separators for your study and exam preparation. ─────────────────────────── 1. Afflict (Verb) • English: To cause pain, distress, or suffering to someone or something. • Amharic: ማሳቀቅ፣ ማሰቃየት፣ በበሽታ ማጠቃት • Synonyms: Torment, Plague, Distress, Burden • Antonyms: Comfort, Relieve, Heal, Assist • Example: Bilharzia is a parasitic disease that afflicts millions of people in developing countries. ─────────────────────────── 2. Ravage (Verb) • English: To cause severe and extensive damage, devastation, or destruction. • Amharic: ማደምሰስ፣ በጽኑ መጉዳት/ማፍረስ • Synonyms: Devastate, Destroy, Ruin, Wreck • Antonyms: Protect, Build, Restore, Repair • Example: The experiment was part of a fight against a disease that ravages three continents. ─────────────────────────── 3. Insidious (Adjective) • English: Proceeding in a gradual, subtle way, but with harmful effects. • Amharic: ድብቅ አደገኛ፣ በሂደት ተንኮል አዘል ጉዳት የሚያደርስ • Synonyms: Treacherous, Subtly harmful, Stealthy, Crafty • Antonyms: Straightforward, Harmless, Honest, Direct • Example: Bilharzia is an insidious enemy because its symptoms develop slowly over time. ─────────────────────────── 4. Invariably (Adverb) • English: In every case or on every occasion; always and without change. • Amharic: ሁልጊዜም ቢሆን፣ ያለልዩነት፣ ሳይለወጥ • Synonyms: Always, Consistently, Without exception, Permanently • Antonyms: Never, Sometimes, Seldom, Rarely • Example: Bilharzia is invariably a problem among poorer communities with poor sanitation. ─────────────────────────── 5. Debilitate / Debilitating (Verb / Adjective) • English: Making someone weak, infirm, or lacking energy. • Amharic: አቅም የሚያሳንስ፣ የሚያደክም፣ የሚያዳክም • Synonyms: Weakening, Enfeebling, Crippling, Exhausting • Antonyms: Strengthening, Invigorating, Fortifying • Example: Bilharzia is a debilitating disease that saps energy and reduces productivity. ─────────────────────────── 6. Offensive (Noun / Adjective) • English: An organized campaign or attack against something; aggressive action. • Amharic: የማጥቃት ዘመቻ፣ ወረራ • Synonyms: Campaign, Attack, Onslaught, Drive • Antonyms: Defense, Resistance, Retreat • Example: The project in Adwa was part of a major health offensive against the parasite. ─────────────────────────── 7. Inevitable (Adjective) • English: Certain to happen; unavoidable. • Amharic: የማይቀር፣ ሊወገድ የማይችል • Synonyms: Unavoidable, Inescapable, Certain, Sure • Antonyms: Avoidable, Uncertain, Preventable, Doubtful • Example: In isolated irrigation schemes, reinfection is almost inevitable without proper control. ─────────────────────────── 8. Vital (Adjective) • English: Absolutely necessary, essential, or important for life and success. • Amharic: በጣም አስፈላጊ፣ ወሳኝ፣ መሠረታዊ • Synonyms: Essential, Crucial, Critical, Indispensable • Antonyms: Unimportant, Minor, Secondary, Trivial • Example: The availability of low-cost local plant extracts is a vital factor in controlling the disease. ─────────────────────────── 9. Vulnerable (Adjective) • English: Exposed to the possibility of being attacked, harmed, or infected. • Amharic: ለጉዳት/ለበሽታ የተጋለጠ • Synonyms: Exposed, Unprotected, Susceptible, At risk • Antonyms: Protected, Immune, Safe, Secure • Example: Young children who swim in the rivers are particularly vulnerable to infection. ─────────────────────────── 10. Abundant (Adjective) • English: Existing or available in large quantities; plentiful. • Amharic: እጅግ ብዙ፣ በብዛት የሚገኝ • Synonyms: Plentiful, Copious, Ample, Profuse • Antonyms: Scarce, Rare, Meagre, Lacking • Example: Investigation revealed an abundant population of live snails in the stream. ─────────────────────────── 11. Toxicity (Noun) • English: The degree or quality of being poisonous or harmful to living organisms. • Amharic: መርዛማነት፣ የመርዝ መጠን/ደረጃ • Synonyms: Poisonousness, Lethality, Venomousness • Antonyms: Harmlessness, Safety, Non-toxicity • Example: Endod berries have very low toxicity to mammals and humans. ─────────────────────────── 12. Dilution (Noun) • English: The action of making a liquid weaker or less concentrated by adding water or solvent. • Amharic: ማቅጠንም፣ ውኃ በመቀላቀል የመርዝ/የኬሚካል መጠንን መቀነስ • Synonyms: Reduction, Weakening, Thinning, Attenuation • Antonyms: Concentration, Strengthening, Intensification • Example: Sundried ground endod kills snails at a dilution of 15 to 30 ppm. ─────────────────────────── 13. Potency (Noun) • English: The power, strength, or effectiveness of something (such as a medicine or pesticide). • Amharic: ኃይል፣ ብቃት፣ የኬሚካል/የመድኃኒት ጥንካሬ • Synonyms: Power, Strength, Efficacy, Effectiveness • Antonyms: Weakness, Ineffectiveness, Impotence • Example: Researchers aimed to prevent the loss of potency when endod was cultivated in East Africa. ─────────────────────────── 14. Dispense / Dispensing (Verb / Noun) • English: To distribute, provide, or administer something (such as medicine or solutions). • Amharic: ማከፋፈል፣ መድኃኒት/ኬሚካል መስጠት ወይም ማደል • Synonyms: Distribute, Administer, Supply, Allocate • Antonyms: Withhold, Retain, Collect, Keep • Example: Strict requirements are needed when dispensing synthetic molluscicides to the public. ─────────────────────────── ❤️ Dear EthioFresh Students!
